analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy signal, RSI has returned to neutral territory, and ADX remains in the early stages of trend formation at 20.1. The 5-day price change sequence (+1.04%, -0.20%, +0.78%, -0.15%, -0.78%) shows mixed signals without clear direction. The current price ($82,704.64) is positioned between the swing support ($82,570.72) and resistance ($82,792.21), indicating a lack of clear directional breakout. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $83,202.45) + interpretation of normal band width (7.48%).
[Support & Resistance]

· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + diagnosis of trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.07x) + assessment of normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + specification of entry/wait-and-see conditions.
